meta.name: google-ads-copy
meta.description: Generate and A/B test Google Ads copy. Use when asked to write ad copy, headlines, descriptions, create ad variants, test ad messaging, improve CTR, or generate RSA (Responsive Search Ad) components. Trigger on "ad copy", "write ads", "headlines", "descriptions", "RSA", "responsive search ad", "ad text", "ad creative", "improve CTR", "ad A/B test", "ad variants", "write me an ad", "ad variation experiment", or when the user wants to improve click-through rate on existing ads.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成并A/B测试谷歌广告文案，提升点击率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速创建和优化谷歌搜索广告文案。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and A/B test Google Ads copy to boost CTR.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create and optimize Google Search ad copy.

howto.what: Claude 会按业务上下文和现有广告数据撰写 RSA 广告文案(标题+描述),核对字符上限与固定位置,并用 A/B 实验判断胜出版本;缺少业务上下文时先建议运行 /google-ads-audit。
howto.when: 当你提出“写广告文案”“提升点击率”等广告相关请求,或要求做 A/B 测试时触发。

say.text: 为“搬家服务”广告组写 5 条 RSA 标题和 3 条描述。
say.note: 会先读业务上下文,再生成可用文案。

say.text: 对现有广告做 A/B 测试,比较“速度优先”和“价格优势”两种角度。
say.note: 会创建广告变体实验,交给统计信号判断。

say.text: 我这两条广告点击率低,帮我改动文案并跑实验对比。
say.note: 会结合搜索词与行业基准调整方向。

howto.what_en: Claude writes RSA ad copy (headlines + descriptions) using business context and existing ad data, enforces character limits/pinning, and runs A/B experiments to pick winners. Missing context? It recommends /google-ads-audit first.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests for ad copy, RSA components, or ad A/B testing.

say_en.text: Write 5 RSA headlines and 3 descriptions for the "moving services" ad group.
say_en.note: It reads business context first, then drafts within limits.

say_en.text: A/B test "speed-first" vs "price-value" angles on my current ads.
say_en.note: Sets up an ad variation experiment.

say_en.text: My two ads have low CTR; revise the copy and run an experiment.
say_en.note: It uses search terms and benchmarks to guide changes.
